title: Positivity of the configuration stride
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and Boolean tape symbols, and let $N,T\in\mathbb{N}$. The stride $k(2T+1)+N+3$ is positive.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean symbols
